name: navigation-menu
title: Navigation Menu
description: The site header's menus: pill triggers in medium body-sm with a turning chevron, panels in the blue-10 ring around a white card of rows with blue icon tiles.
usage: Top navigation where a section has several destinations (Products, Use cases, Resources). Give each link a title and one line of description, and lead with the blue tile icon when the rows are products. Plain links sit in the same list with navigationMenuTriggerStyle.
avoid: Actions in the panels (they are for going places)
More than about eight rows in one panel
Hover-only panels with no click or keyboard way in

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
